annotations.title: Create a form without an account

description: Create a form without a Wrenform account, using only the email address that should receive submissions. Wrenform emails that address once to confirm. Until it's confirmed, submissions are held and nothing is forwarded. Unconfirmed forms expire after 7 days. Tell the user to check their inbox and click Confirm. Pass `framework` for the right snippet, and `site_url` only if the site is already deployed (its https address).

email.description: The address that should receive the form's submissions.

framework.description: The site's framework. html needs no JavaScript.

site_url.description: The deployed site's https address, e.g. https://example.com; it becomes the only allowed origin. Omit it if the site isn't deployed yet (a localhost address is ignored).

name: create_quick_form
